{{Quote|I swear you could drill through a moon with the things.|[[Jorn Kulish]]|<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />}}
The '''burrowing plasma charge''' was a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] developed by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for use against hardened targets. The charge was a two-stage weapon: an initial [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] warhead would blast a crater before a secondary [[Shaped charge/Legends|shaped charge]] burrowed through the hole to destroy the target.<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] deployed burrowing plasma charges aboard the [[Ividal Sector Forces]]' [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] during the [[Attack on Ongary IX|counterattack]] at [[Ongary IX]]. The warheads were used to destroy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases entrenched in the planet's [[Mining/Legends|mine]] shafts. Difficulties were encountered when it was found that the extreme brightness of the burrowing plasma charges' explosions would dazzle [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and scramble [[Heads-up display/Legends|head-up displays]], necessitating the application of opaque [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]] to [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmets]] to protect pilots' [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />
